title: OpenText World 2026: What’s in it for the manufacturing industry?
summary: OpenText World 2026 has manufacturing covered! Join us for sessions, breakouts, advisory boards, and more tailored to your needs.
body_markdown:
Manufacturers are under pressure to modernize faster than ever. But standing in the way of success are isolated AI pilots, disconnected information, and fragmented supply chains. How can you build a trusted information foundation to help you overcome these challenges?


[OpenText World 2026](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/summary-1?_gl=1*hsbl23*_gcl_au*NDUxOTgxMjYuMTc4NzY2NjE1Mg..*_ga*MTAzNTY3NTQ4Ni4xNzg3NjY2MTUy*_ga_8LWPJ50ZXY*czE3ODgyNzczNzkkbzYkZzEkdDE3ODgyOTAxMDIkajI3JGwwJGgxMTI4MDczNDgx) in Orlando, October 19–22, is the place to find answers to this question and many more. The event’s manufacturing focus—including speaker sessions, breakouts, advisory boards, and forums—offers insight and advice about what’s on your mind today and what to think about for tomorrow.


Hilary Johnson, OpenText Manufacturing Senior Industry Strategist, talks about what’s in store at OpenText 2026.


New to this year’s conference is the **Industry Advisory Board** for manufacturing. This focused gathering brings together senior industry leaders to discuss trends, challenges, and innovation opportunities. Participation is open to interested attendees and subject to approval to ensure a curated peer-to-peer experience. Find more information[here](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/websitePage:b0383cbf-303c-4682-8546-a9e6973ac530) .


Join us for the **[Manufacturing Industry Forum](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/websitePage:2823e135-e0a7-4c13-8d7a-2f69abc9416d?session=4866d23e-7ef3-4ec1-b43f-6606f5c9b754&shareLink=true)** (Wednesday, 11:30 a.m.) to find out how peers from across the industry are moving AI to the core of their supply chains. You’ll also hear from **Simon Ellis, Group Vice President at IDC** , who will offer his perspectives on manufacturing and supply chain strategies. And two enterprise manufacturers who are using AI will share their experiences and expectations.


The conference also offers use cases, client success stories, how-to sessions, product roadmaps, round tables, and more. Here are just a few with a manufacturing lens that you won’t want to miss:


**[Product showcase – From data to decisions: Building the digital foundation for the agentic enterprise](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/websitePage:2823e135-e0a7-4c13-8d7a-2f69abc9416d?session=91767f9e-13fd-429e-b253-c691a3ddb592&shareLink=true)**


Tuesday, 11:30 a.m.


Hear about how to transform data into actionable insights that power smarter, faster decisions for your enterprise. Learn how to make data quality non-negotiable, connect your ecosystem without friction, and turn information into decisions your business can act on with confidence.


**[Unlocking visibility into your B2B data: Hands-on with the latest innovations](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/websitePage:2823e135-e0a7-4c13-8d7a-2f69abc9416d?session=d530042f-5126-4f42-a663-b32d3428f294&shareLink=true)**


Tuesday, 2:00 p.m.


In this session we provide a detailed, hands-on update on the latest innovations in data visibility and intelligence and demonstrate how you can maximize the value of your B2B data.


**[Manufacturing industry client connect](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/websitePage:2823e135-e0a7-4c13-8d7a-2f69abc9416d?session=ad50fc58-e71d-4751-af8a-59a87d888015&shareLink=true)**


Tuesday, 3:15 p.m.


Meet others who are navigating similar manufacturing priorities, from AI and supply-chain resilience to data, operations, and growth. Exchange ideas, compare perspectives, ask the questions that matter most, and make connections that extend beyond OpenText World.


**[How a major manufacturer automated order-to-cash with a committee of AI agents](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/websitePage:2823e135-e0a7-4c13-8d7a-2f69abc9416d?session=b762c9a4-8a4f-455f-bafd-7301cf26ca1d&shareLink=true)**


Wednesday, 1:00 p.m.


Learn how a major manufacturer orchestrated a multi-agent workflow to classify and route complex orders, cutting manual effort and accelerating cash flow at global scale.


Check our[webpage](https://web.cvent.com/event/120ea660-a853-4aef-af15-90b5768d6b4f/websitePage:2823e135-e0a7-4c13-8d7a-2f69abc9416d?session=7b993b06-54a0-4275-946b-a5b2359da862&shareLink=true) often for newly added sessions.
